title: "Search the Memoir"

This is a static browser-based search over the memoir chunks. It does not require a server.

<div class="search-card">
  <label for="uv-search"><strong>Search the corpus</strong></label>
  <input id="uv-search" type="search" placeholder="Try: Marion, CIA, Montevideo, USS Wasp, Idaho Falls" />
  <button id="uv-search-button">Search</button>
</div>

<div id="uv-search-status" class="muted"></div>
<div id="uv-search-results"></div>

<script src="assets/js/search.js"></script>
